name: Double Probe
rule: Ask up to 2 questions this turn (same or different targets). Answers are public.

name: Misdirect
rule: Ask 1 question; the target answers SECRETLY to you only (yes/no token, hidden from others).

name: Eavesdrop
rule: Choose a target and one trait; the target secretly shows you their value for that trait.

name: Cross-Examine
rule: Ask the same question to 2 different targets. Answers are public.

name: Wild Probe
rule: Ask any yes/no trait question, even if you don't hold that question card. Answer is public.
